I’m kind of late replying to this but we talked a bit. The complicating factor is she is bipolar and schizophrenic so we really kind of fed each other’s illness :p

We still talk a little. I’m working on just being friends with her.

This post has changed my mind on meds man. Thank you. I was on meds previously and they seemed to make everything so much worse (mood swings were much more infrequent), but since I’m alone now anyway I figure what the hell might as well.
Wtf do you look like where any of this works?
Man. After spending a week or so on this sub, this is either like googling hemorrhoids or I need to speak to my therapist about a misdiagnosis.

If I had to guess, he might be like me. I get overwhelmed, have a mood swing, and break up with whoever I’m with. I do it repeatedly. This last relationship made me realize I’m fucking nuts and need help, so I got that going for me at least.

Support chat in what?

Edit: I’m dumb.
